answers.explanation: It asks the system for information and formats it.
Moving and renaming files as whole objects is file management.
Searching or transforming file contents is file modification.
Remote login is a communications program. (The sshd it connects to is a daemon.)
Runs from boot to shutdown, provides printing: a daemon.
It doesn't pertain to the system. It's an application.
Debuggers are listed with compilers and interpreters.
Detailed performance information is status information.
